items.title: Brazil
kv: BCB's March 2026 prudential segmentation places BB, Bradesco, BTG Pactual, Caixa, Itaú and Santander in S1. Their verified digital-asset states differ: Itaú offers app-based BTC, ETH and USDC trading with bank custody; BTG offers crypto trading/custody, markets BTG Dol and is the fund manager named in the CSD BR mirror; Banco do Brasil distributes a crypto-exposure fund and, with Caixa and cooperatives, signed the September mortgage-tokenization development agreement; Caixa, Bradesco and Santander have Drex or tokenization pilot/development evidence but no reviewed public token-money launch. Nubank, though not S1, is a material retail intermediary whose current terms cover buy, sell, swap, custody and selected on-chain transfers. A cutoff SPSAV cohort by CNPJ and final/in-process state remains unavailable.

S1 membership, brand, conglomerate, Brazilian legal person, bank licence, SPSAV modality, securities-fund exposure, direct virtual-asset custody, stablecoin issuer, Drex pilot node and settlement participant are different roles.
